name: Tombstones
overview: Scripture reminds believers of the brevity and significance of life, urging us to 'number our days' wisely (Psalms 90:12) and to trust in God's eternal provision and rest beyond this life (Isaiah 66:1; Psalms 23:6). The passing of faithful servants like Moses marks transitions under God's sovereign guidance (Joshua 1:1), while the preservation of the elect amid trials underscores His protective care (Matthew 24:22). Though the physical marker of a tombstone signifies death, Scripture points us to the hope of dwelling forever in the house of the LORD.
